title: Fairness in Robust Unit Commitment Problem Considering Suppression of Renewable Energy
summary: Power company operators make power generation plans one day in advance, in what is known as the Unit Commitment (UC) problem. UC is exposed to uncertainties, such as unknown electricity load and disturbances caused by renewable energy sources, especially PVs. In previous research, we proposed the Renewable Energy Robust Optimization Problem (RE-RP), which solves these uncertainties by considering suppression.
